name: araxys
summary: Plug & play security library for FastAPI — CORS, CSRF, IP blocking, rate limiting, honeypots, JWT (RS256/ES256), API keys, brute force, sessions, OTEL, Prometheus metrics, encrypted audit logging with async I/O, CSP headers, sanitization (NoSQL/command/path-traversal), database security (connection pooling, TLS, secrets, query audit), and SQL injection parser (sqlparse).
author: Samuel Esteban Urrego Valencia
